last.verdict: AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, up roughly 27% from the third quarter, as its new AI racks begin shipping in volume.

takeaways.label: Data center surge
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 45% to $13.4B. Data center sales jumped 97% to $8.5B, helped by the launch of the MI450 AI chips. PC and gaming sales fell 8%.

takeaways.label: Huge Q4 guide
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to about $17B, plus or minus 3%, with AMD saying growth will speed up as it scales Helios AI racks and 'Venice' server chips.

takeaways.label: Margin slips
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin was 56% in Q3 but is guided to about 55% for Q4, so the margin falls a point even as revenue jumps.

takeaways.label: Cash flow thinning
takeaways.text: Free cash flow fell to $554M from $1.56B in Q2. Inventory rose to $11.5B and debt more than doubled to $7.1B from $3.2B.

history.verdict: Solid beat and strong outlook, but the stock had run too far, too fast.

reasons.label: Sky-high expectations
reasons.text: Stock jumped 21% in the five days before the report, so a modest beat wasn't enough.

reasons.label: Flat profit margin outlook
reasons.text: Gross margin guided to 56% for next quarter, unchanged from this quarter's 56%.

reasons.label: Cash flow and AI timing
reasons.text: Free cash flow fell 39% as spending doubled; big Helios AI rack sales come later.
